summary: Crescent Capital BDC, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) reporting the prepayment of $50 million in aggregate principal of its 7.54% senior unsecured notes due July 28, 2026. The company exercised its option under the Master Note Purchase Agreement and paid approximately $51.6 million, including accrued interest, extinguishing the notes entirely. This is a routine debt repayment, not a special situation such as a capital return or restructuring. No stock or assets were involved, and no strategic event is indicated. No action for investors or risk-arb angle; the filing is purely informational.
